h1: Custom window graphics for shop windows
estratto: Make your windows more visible and recognizable with custom window graphics: types, lifespan and costs for your business in Ticino.

paragrafi: Your shop window is the first point of contact between a passer-by and your store. Custom window graphics are not just decoration: they are a marketing tool that boosts visibility, strengthens your brand and improves the privacy of your interiors.
In this guide you'll see why they work, which types to choose and what you need to know about lifespan and costs.

sezioni.heading: Why choose custom window graphics
paragrafi: A well-designed window conveys professionalism before the customer even walks in. With your logo, brand colors and a clear message, your store stands out from the competition and stays memorable.
lista: More visibility: a striking design catches the eye of passers-by.
Brand identity: your logo and colors tell people what your business is all about at a glance.
Privacy without darkness: frosted or perforated films protect your interiors while letting light in.
Flexible promotions: removable versions can be updated for sales, events and seasons.

sezioni.heading: Which type of window graphic to choose
paragrafi: The right solution depends on the effect you're after: color and impact, privacy, or short-term messaging.
lista: Colored vinyls: vibrant logos and graphics, ideal for fashion, restaurants and creative businesses.
Frosted and sandblasted effect: elegant and discreet, perfect for offices and professional studios.
Perforated (one-way vision): you can see out from the inside but not in from the outside, great for advertising on glass.
Temporary removable: for offers, events and holidays, they peel off without leaving residue.

sezioni.heading: Lifespan, materials and costs
paragrafi: Indoors, window graphics last for many years; outdoors, their lifespan ranges from about 3 to 7 years depending on the film and exposure. We work with professional-grade materials (3M, Oracal and similar) for stable colors and lasting durability.

The cost depends on the surface to be covered, the type of film and the complexity of the graphics. For a large window, professional installation prevents bubbles and creases and guarantees a clean result. We provide a free quote with an on-site visit in Ticino.

sezioni.heading: Your window, your business card
paragrafi: A well-designed window works for you every single day: it improves visibility, strengthens your brand and attracts new customers.
Get in touch for a free consultation and give your window a professional, tailor-made look.

faq.domanda: How long do window graphics last?
faq.risposta: Indoors they last for many years without any issues. Outdoors, their lifespan ranges from about 3 to 7 years, depending on the type of film and exposure to sun and weather.

faq.domanda: How much does a custom window graphic cost?
faq.risposta: The price depends on the surface to be covered, the type of film and the graphics. For an accurate cost, we'll prepare a free quote with an on-site visit in Ticino.

faq.domanda: Do window graphics reduce the light inside the shop?
faq.risposta: No. Frosted and perforated films provide privacy while still letting natural light through. One-way perforated film also lets you see out from the inside.

faq.domanda: Can they be removed without damaging the glass?
faq.risposta: Yes. There are removable window graphics that peel off without leaving residue, ideal for promotions and temporary messaging. Clean removal is easiest within the first few years.

faq.domanda: Can I apply them myself or do I need a professional?
faq.risposta: For small surfaces, DIY is possible. For large windows, professional installation is the way to go: it prevents bubbles and creases and ensures better alignment and durability.
